about_the_game:
Inside the Crow 's Nest is a Survival Horror game inspired by old-school genre classics.

You play as the Hunter, who awakens in a cell marked with strange symbols, trapped in a cult-infested monastery. To escape, you must survive horrifying cultists, uncover dark secrets, and solve intricate puzzles that block your escape.

Nostalgic Survival Horror Feel:

Experience tense, atmospheric gameplay with fixed camera angles and tank controls - an homage to the pioneers of the genre.

Challenging, Rewarding Puzzles

Collect clues, decipher their meaning, and use them to navigate and unlock new areas of the cursed monastery.

Relentless Cultists and Monstrous Horrors

Face off against twisted followers of The Forgotten One—inhuman abominations warped by devotion to their dark god.

A Mystery Waiting to Be Uncovered

Delve deep into the monastery’s haunted halls and piece together the chilling history of its inhabitants and their eldritch faith. Will the Hunter escape, or become the next sacrifice?

content_descriptors.notes:
Our game centers on an arcane cult that aims to resurrect an ancient deity. To accomplish this, they have kidnapped the protagonist. Their plan is to sacrifice him to summon a god who will unleash chaos and terror upon the Earth.

The game features dark, eerie locations, mysterious figures whose state—alive or dead—is uncertain, enemies with features resembling cadaverous birds, and an environmental narrative in which stains and filth create a disturbing atmosphere.

You will shoot your crossbow against the enemies, who will fall dead and disappear. And once you pick up the doomed dagger, you will hear unsettling whispers.
